title.narrative: % (#) of member LNNGOs which submit proposals in countries where an alert has been raised

description.narrative: Standard Start Fund alert data collection. This should only include LNNGOs which have been onboardedBaseline:Baseline Value: 0.75Baseline Comment: 75% baseline rateTarget:Target Value: 0.78Target Comment: 78% target ratePeriod (2024):Period Start: 2024-01-01Period End: 2024-12-31Target Value: 0.75Actual Value: 0.67Period Comment: In the reporting period, alerts were raised and activated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), El Salvador, Guatemala, and India. Out of 9 LNNGO members present in these countries, 6 submitted proposals (67%). While this is below the set target of 75% for 2024, this is due to the fact that multiple LNNGO members in DRC were on restricted access to the Start Fund and therefore could not submit proposals for project funding during the reporting period. The % was calculated out of the total number of LNNGO present in countries where an alert was activated, rather than raised, as the proposals are submitted only for activated alerts (in the reporting period, for example, alerts were also raised in Pakistan and Sri Lanka, but not activated).
